title: DJ Emocean
bio: From warehouse raves to desert grooves—DJ Emocean (Liz Lapp) blends old-school and modern dance/pop. Also runs Hi Desert Times magazine shop in Twentynine Palms. Connection matters.
showDescription: Play It As It Lays is a series of curated dance sets, each one a complete mood. DJ Emocean explores themes through carefully selected tracks—sultry grooves, pop moments, underground heat—creating immersive listening experiences designed for both the body and the heart.
